title: Microfinance asset quality improves further as loans at risk fall to 2.3% in June: CRIF
summary: Microfinance asset quality stress eased further in June, with portfolio at risk falling to 2.3 percent. Average ticket size rose to Rs 62,100 as lenders focused on existing borrowers. Microfinance disbursements stood at Rs 61,100 crore in the first quarter.

title: AI in this decade is what digitsation was in the last: RBI governor

title: AI in banking must move beyond retail to farms, MSMEs: SBI Chairman Setty
